answer.approach: Build accessibility audit as semantic markup first; use utilities for spacing, layout, type and state feedback. Include this evidence: focus-visible:, sr-only, aria-, motion-reduce:, min-h-.
review_checklist: Test keyboard focus and narrow-screen layout.
Check meaningful alternative text and contrast when relevant.
